name: The majority voted against a motion introduced by Deakin MP [Michael Sukkar](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/representatives/deakin/michael_sukkar) (Liberal), which means it failed. ### Motion text > *That so much of the standing and sessional orders be suspended as would prevent the following from occurring:* > > *(1) government business order of the day No. 5 relating to the [Treasury Laws Amendment (Tax Incentives and Integrity) Bill 2024](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id%3A%22legislation%2Fbillhome%2Fr7299%22) being called on immediately; and* > > *(2) all questions required to complete passage of the bill being put without delay.* Standing and sessional orders are the usual procedural rules of parliament.
